terms.service_term: Not restated in March9 letter; expressly under February28 act: not less than twelve months unless sooner discharged; existing enlistment terms retained.
terms.organisation: State forces received with officers by company, battalion or regiment under incorporated act; letter requests infantry by headcount.
terms.appointments: Existing unit officers retained under February28 section4; President appoints generals with congressional consent.
terms.arms_equipment: March9 letter does not allocate arms/equipment cost. February28 permits States to turn over arms; permission is not a promise of supply.
terms.destination: State-specific coastal/fort destinations, expanded per instance.
terms.other_conditions: Immediate movement; muster on arrival; avoid publishing order if supply can be immediate, to conceal movements from US.
terms.limits: Charleston3000 and Texas1000 are requirements, not individually addressed governor quotas in printed distribution note; those two model allocations remain [I]. No invented equipment obligation.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Incorporated act requires State consent and retains officers. No union honour: these are Confederate provisional forces. Mere fort destination does not warrant glory/caution tags.

terms.service_term: Letter silent on length; invokes March6 public-defense act: volunteers twelve months after muster unless sooner discharged; six-month militia provision is distinct.
terms.organisation: Volunteers drilled, equipped and held ready, not an immediate muster. Incorporated act accepts companies/squadrons/battalions/regiments.
terms.appointments: Incorporated March6 act: unit officers by State law; President groups units and appoints brigade/division commanders and additional supply/medical staff.
terms.arms_equipment: Governor to prepare equipped troops; act: volunteers clothe themselves, mounted men provide horses/tack, arms by State OR Confederate government. No exclusive State arms duty.
terms.destination: Readiness within State; no destination specified pending requisition.
terms.other_conditions: Instant ability to move; no pay before muster. April22 clarification: conditional companies not mustered until absolute call.
terms.limits: Do not create active levy on readiness or infer an actual date of departure.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Text expressly prepares resistance to Washington coercion. The autonomy reading concerns that stated purpose, not a governor answer; incorporated State appointments remain explicit.

terms.service_term: Same terms as April8 incorporated call; twelve-month volunteers unless sooner discharged, starting at muster.
terms.organisation: Additional readiness force, same conditions as April8; no immediate active muster.
terms.appointments: Same incorporated March6 State unit appointment and Confederate higher/staff authority as CS-A08.
terms.arms_equipment: Armed and equipped, or as nearly so as practicable. This express qualification must survive; March6 permits either State or Confederate arming.
terms.destination: Held ready for instant movement; destination not specified.
terms.other_conditions: Additional to April8, not replacement; pressing readiness linked to received US proclamation. No pay/muster before activation.
terms.limits: Full equipment is requested with practicability qualification, not an absolute arms admission bar.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Own text says hostile Washington purpose and incorporates the earlier resistance call. Do not turn readiness into a glory demand.

terms.service_term: Georgia/Louisiana/Mississippi letters refer to public-defense law rather than restating length: twelve-month volunteers unless sooner discharged. Alabama refers to previous State raising regulations, not reprinted in its letter.
terms.organisation: Infantry regiments; Georgia/Louisiana/Mississippi conform as far as possible to public-defense law; Alabama to prior raising regulations.
terms.appointments: Referenced March6 law retains State-law unit appointments and Confederate general/staff authority. Alabama letter does not restate its prior appointment regulations.
terms.arms_equipment: Transportation/subsistence federally provided from departure (explicit Alabama; accordingly in telegrams). Arms not separately allocated in these letters; incorporated law allows State OR Confederate supply, volunteers own clothing with commutation.
terms.destination: AL/MS Lynchburg; GA/LA Richmond; muster at governor-designated place, Alabama expressly within or outside State.
terms.other_conditions: Without delay/earliest possible; answer requested. Louisiana one regiment, second only if ready. Activation draws on readiness; not all readiness totals added anew.
terms.limits: Do not import Brown April23 election/Augusta proposal or Moore camp finance complaint into the April22 issuer text.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Minimal own-text mapping: a regiment to a destination alone supplies no universal union/duty/glory tag. State officer rights belong to the incorporated law and can be represented structurally without presuming every clause is a value reward.

terms.service_term: Not less than twelve months unless sooner discharged.
terms.organisation: Ten infantry companies of at least64 men each; colonel/lieutenant-colonel/major, adjutant from lieutenants and sergeant-major from enlisted; each company captain/first lieutenant/two seconds/four sergeants/four corporals/two musicians.
terms.appointments: Officers except staff appointed according to State law; staff by Confederate President.
terms.arms_equipment: Volunteers furnish uniform with commutation; Confederate arms/ammunition sent to Harpers Ferry or governor-designated point; transport and subsistence from departure.
terms.destination: KY Harpers Ferry; AR Lynchburg; NC Richmond; TN Lynchburg. Muster at destination in adapted letter.
terms.other_conditions: Aid Virginia against stated common Southern enemy; answer whether and when; KY1/AR1/NC1/TN3 regiments.
terms.limits: State permission to raise/send and Confederate military authority are distinct. The letter itself does not prove Tennessee legal authority existed.
terms.value_rationale: [I] The KY letter explicitly opposes US coercion of Confederate States and preserves State-law unit appointments; adapted AR/NC/TN letters share its terms. No actor-specific legality penalty invented.

terms.service_term: For the war.
terms.organisation: Two additional regiments, expressly outside forthcoming reserve corps.
terms.appointments: Not specified in this letter. Do not import June30 independent-company field appointments.
terms.arms_equipment: Not specified in this letter; no express arms admission condition.
terms.destination: Corinth, Mississippi, for protection of Mississippi Valley.
terms.other_conditions: Raise if possible; separate from reserve.
terms.limits: Later Moore reply says Memphis and dates his received requisition June30; preserve difference, not a correction to original Corinth/June29.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Explicit protection of the Mississippi Valley supports order. No named appointment or arms clause permits an autonomy offence or equipment bar here.

terms.service_term: For the war.

terms.appointments: President assigns camp officers and appoints field and staff. Company-officer selection not restated in call; May8 act has company election/Presidential commissioning [legal context only].
terms.arms_equipment: Arms explicitly NOT prerequisite to acceptance. Camp control War Department; original call does not explicitly allocate every camp subsistence invoice.
terms.destination: Accessible camps in each State, selected by governor; no permanent front destination specified.
terms.other_conditions: Precaution for public safety; national30000;3000 each except TX2000/FL1000. Federal camp control and instruction.
terms.limits: Do not convert hopes that many are armed into a mandatory State arms demand, or Moore/Brown later support conditions into original text.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Own text stresses precaution and public safety; federal assembly and field appointment displace State control. No union reward and no promise to retain State brigade commanders.

terms.service_term: [I] Supplemental companies for the same war corps; cavalry paragraph does not separately restate duration.
terms.organisation: Two cavalry companies per AL/AR/GA/MS/TN;60-100 privates each, captain/first lieutenant/two seconds/four sergeants/four corporals/farrier/blacksmith/two musicians.
terms.appointments: Cavalry paragraph silent on field appointments; company forms, no guaranteed State regimental command.

terms.destination: Corinth, Mississippi, with companies from other States; expressly not State instruction camps.
terms.other_conditions: Supplement to infantry reserve; drilled by suitable officers before field service.
terms.limits: Do not use infantry no-arms prerequisite for cavalry or invent fixed200 men/State.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Purpose is completing the precautionary corps. No explicit cavalry field-appointment clause supports automatically copying infantry autonomy offence.

terms.service_term: For the war.
terms.organisation: Two additional infantry regiments, distinct from June30 reserve.
terms.appointments: Troops select their own officers including field; President appoints assistant quartermaster/commissary/surgeon/assistant surgeon.
terms.arms_equipment: Regiments armed and equipped; early field readiness requested.
terms.destination: Field, no specific place named.
terms.other_conditions: Expressly additional to reserve; prompt practicable readiness.
terms.limits: No requirement to break an existing State brigade in this letter. Brown interpretation is separate; July12 specific demand is separate.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Own text explicitly preserves selection of regimental officers. Federal staff appointment alone is not treated as identical to reserve field appointments; no inferred union honour.

terms.service_term: Three months unless sooner discharged.
terms.organisation: Detached militia as infantry or foot riflemen; April16 plan gives ten-company regiments, brigades4+regiments, divisions2+brigades.
terms.appointments: Call and April16 organisation sheet do not specify appointment authority. Do not retrofit May4 volunteer governor-appointment plan onto this militia call.
terms.arms_equipment: Call itself silent on who supplies arms/equipment/uniforms; subsequent correspondence must be separately sourced.
terms.destination: State-specific rendezvous on p69; first eventual service probably repossess seized forts/places/property, not an unconditional Washington destination.
terms.other_conditions: Immediate detachment; governor gives expected rendezvous date; US officer musters/oath every officer/man; enlisted age18-45 and physical strength. Proclamation orders dispersal in20days, avoids devastation/interference with property/disturbance of peaceful citizens consistently with object.
terms.limits: 75000 proclamation is distinct from73391 quota aggregate; PA16 reduced14 April16. Hypothetical larger_longer option has no separate historical call text.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Proclamation expressly preserves National Union and executes its laws; armed repossession overrides claimed State control of seized federal property. Autonomy offence is this objective [I], not a claim that all governors disputed their own appointments. Peaceful-citizen restraint is retained structurally; no inferred abolition or slavery value.

terms.service_term: Volunteers three years unless sooner discharged;18000 seamen one-three years. Regular increase directed separately; do not infer its enlistment length from volunteer clause.
terms.organisation: 42034 maximum volunteers; May4 GO15:39 infantry/one cavalry regiment; infantry ten companies, cavalry4-6squadrons of two companies; brigades/divisions.
terms.appointments: GO15 governors appoint volunteer company/field; colonel selects adjutant/quartermaster/NCO staff; President with Senate appoints brigade/division staff except general selects aides; chaplain by regimental commander on officers vote.
terms.arms_equipment: GO15 clothing allowance infantry$2.50/cavalry$3 monthly; cavalry enlisted supply horse/tack,50c daily use/risk, serve on foot if lacking serviceable horse; travel allowances, disability/death benefits and bounty specified. General arms supplier not expressly allocated here.
terms.destination: National service; no single field destination in proclamation/GO15.
terms.other_conditions: Enforcement laws/suppression insurrection, restore peace/order; organization submitted to Congress; GO15 promotion from ranks shares preserved.
terms.limits: Do not allocate42034 as another levy alongside state quotas or add seamen to governor infantry calls.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Proclamation explicitly preserves Union and suppresses insurrection. National coercive purpose persists; unit officer State appointment is preserved structurally rather than cancelling the objective.

terms.appointments: Letter does not specify appointing authority; May4 plan is later and not incorporated in this acceptance.
terms.arms_equipment: New York arms/equips; US assumes pay/instruction/subsistence at depot.
terms.destination: State depot(s) War Department designates.
terms.other_conditions: Existing uniformed militia relieved when tendered troops mustered.
terms.limits: Acceptance of tender, not a uniform national three-year call.
terms.value_rationale: [I] Accepted tender text contains no explicit Union preservation/objective or officer-rights clause; leave value arrays empty rather than borrow from neighbouring proclamation or later answer.

terms.destination: Regular recruiting/organisation, no field destination specified.
terms.other_conditions: Central raising separate from State volunteer quotas; GO16 detailed staff/promotions.
terms.limits: Model1095-day representation is not sourced by GO16 volunteer analogy; original regular force has unknown actual strength.
